record.question: Who is the Supreme Commander of the Defence Forces of the Union of India?
record.explanation: Answer B: President. The President of India is Supreme Commander of the Defence Forces under Article 53 and service statutes. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
